abstract: Primary mediastinal malignant germinoma is a rare disease, and only about 15 patients have been reported in Japan. We treated a patient with this disease by intra-arterial CDDP infusion and observed good effects. A 29 year-old male was admitted to our hospital due to SVC syndrome in 1980. A right mediastinal tumor was detected, and the resection of this tumor was performed. Histological examination showed seminoma. Though postoperative Co irradiation was performed, radiation pneumonitis developed in the right lung. Subsequently, the tumor metastasized to the right kidney and spinal cord. After removal of the right kidney followed by Co irradiation, the clinical course was good. In 1987, a mass (10 x 6 cm) was detected in the left mediastinum, suggesting recurrence. Four courses of CDDP infusion into the left bronchial artery and left internal thoracic artery (1 course: 45-70 mg) were performed, and good effects were obtained. No side effects were observed, and the clinical course has been good until now. This case is of interest in evaluating the multidisciplinary treatment for mediastinal seminoma.
abstract_ja: 原発性縦隔悪性ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）は稀な疾患で、日本では約15例が報告されているにすぎない。我々は本疾患の患者1例に対して動脈内CDDP注入を行い、良好な効果を得た。29歳の男性が1980年に上大静脈症候群で当院に入院した。右縦隔腫瘍が検出され、外科的切除が施行された。組織学的検査でセミノーマであった。術後にCo照射が行われたが、右肺に放射線肺臓炎が発生した。その後、腫瘍は右腎臓および脊髄に転移した。右腎摘除後にCo照射を行い、臨床経過は良好であった。1987年、左縦隔に腫瘤（10×6 cm）が検出され、再発が示唆された。左気管支動脈および左内胸動脈へのCDDP注入（1コース：45〜70 mg）を4コース施行し、良好な効果が得られた。副作用は認められず、現在まで臨床経過は良好である。本症例は、縦隔セミノーマに対する多職種連携治療を評価するうえで興味深い。
